def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])

    def ll(Z):
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta))
            w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = Z.T @ (Z * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-8: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))

    C = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False)
    alpha = 0.01 / p
    sel = []
    base = ll(S)
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        best, bj = None, None
        Z0 = np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel])
        for j in range(p):
            if j in sel or any(abs(C[j, k]) >= 0.6 for k in sel): continue
            l1 = ll(np.column_stack([Z0, X[:, j]]))
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (l1 - base), 1)
            if best is None or pv < best[0]: best, bj = (pv, l1), j
        if bj is None or best[0] >= alpha: break
        sel.append(bj); base = best[1]
    # backward survival check
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        full = ll(np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel]))
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            l0 = ll(np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, k] for k in rest]))
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - l0), 1) >= alpha:
                sel.remove(j); changed = True; break
    # interaction screen
    prods = []
    Zs = np.column_stack([S] + [X[:, j] for j in sel])
    npair = p * (p + 1) / 2; bestp = None
    for a in range(p):
        for b in range(a, p):
            if a != b and abs(C[a, b]) >= 0.6: continue
            Zab = np.column_stack([Zs, X[:, a]] + ([X[:, b]] if b != a else []))
            l1 = ll(np.column_stack([Zab, X[:, a] * X[:, b]]))
            pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (l1 - ll(Zab)), 1)
            if bestp is None or pv < bestp[0]: bestp = (pv, a, b)
    if bestp is not None and bestp[0] < 0.01 / npair:
        _, a, b = bestp
        prods.append((ids[a], ids[b]))
        for j in (a, b):
            if j not in sel and len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS: sel.append(j)
    drivers = tuple(ids[j] for j in sel)
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=drivers, products=tuple(prods), loadings={})
